column1: # Every DBC table the 3.3.5a client loads (WoW.exe build 12340), one row per table loader.
# 237 load at startup through the run at 0x6337d0 (`loaded_by=startup`); the rest are loaded by the named function.
# columns / row_size are the loader's literal header checks: a file of any other width is a fatal error.
# game_table is the slot a gt table is read through (0x7f6990(slot, row, column)).
# readers are the functions naming an address inside the 0x24-byte table object (or passing its
# literal game-table slot), past its load site and static destructor. They are a floor: a read through a
# computed pointer is not seen. lua lists the Lua bindings (`:Name` a widget method) and opcodes the
# incoming opcodes whose registered handler is itself a reader; a reader reached through a helper is
# 241 tables; 10 with no reader: the client loads them and never reads them.
